newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: BOK says to absorb 600 bln won through repos.
newsitem.headline: BOK says to absorb 600 bln won through repos.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea said on Tuesday it would absorb 600 billion won until Wednesday through repurchase agreements.
"We decided to siphon off money from the banking system, which showed signs of excess liquidity due to money supply from the state budget," a central bank official said.
He said the foreign exchange market had recently become a source of the won supply because of the dollar's weakness against the yen.
